bio: Independent type designer from Baroda, now based in London, focused on bringing Indic scripts into contemporary digital type design. Studied at MIT Institute of Design, Pune, completing her final project with the Indian Type Foundry in 2013 and continuing to work with the foundry since. Designed typefaces including Kalam, Tillana, Pancho Devanagari, and Ikat (Devanagari and Latin).

sources.title: Lipi Raval — Indian Type Foundry designer profile
